summary: The callers of the reach the record lacked: the terrain twin of CommandEffect and the AI's pulling in of a headquarters.

addresses.name: CUnit::TerrainCommandEffect
addresses.signature: int* __thiscall CUnit::TerrainCommandEffect(CUnit* this, int* out, int effectType, std::string* terrain)
addresses.comment: CUnit::CommandEffect with a terrain: where the unit has a higher_oob_unit (+0x1E0), that unit's own TerrainCommandEffect (recursive) - where not 0 - times max(CommandReachFrom, 0) / 1000, then * 1000 / 2000; plus, where its leader (+0x12C) is not the null leader, every trait effect of the kind whose terrain name - kept beside each value, from +0xF8 in steps of 0x1C - equals the string given. Kind 28 (terrain_speed) from CUnit::MovementSpeedModifier and BuildSpeedModifierTooltip; terrain_attack and terrain_defence from CLandCombatant::ApplyCombatModifiers. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-commandreach.md, section 12.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled C of 0x5D0F80, `ret 0xC` at 0x5D111C; the call at 0x5C8F07 pushes 0x1C and the terrain's name. Callers 0x56AAAB, 0x56AAF1, 0x5C84F3, 0x5C8F07.

addresses.name: CAIUnit_PullHeadquartersIn
addresses.comment: Over the AI agent's units (+0x14C..+0x150), skipping its own unit (+0x64), one retreating, and one in a battle it may not leave: a unit with no destination of its own is moved with CEU3AI::MoveUnit to the province 0x8DA660 picks for it, where it can reach it, when any unit directly under it is reached by 999 or less of its command (CUnit::CommandReachFrom), or when its +0x1A8 is set, or when it stands on a front province and the agent's +0x364 is set. Answers whether it moved anything. So the AI walks a headquarters towards subordinates out of its full reach. Read for its shape only; the name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-commandreach.md, section 12.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled C of 0x8CC320, `ret 4` at 0x8CC44B; one caller, CAIUnit::Tick at 0x8B0BF5.
